title: Every Edge Needs a Quote: Building a Quote-Grounded Knowledge Graph of Healthcare Software Adoption with Language-Model Agents
title_zh: 每条边都需要一条引文：用语言模型智能体构建以引文为据的医疗软件采用知识图谱

paragraphs.en: Correspondence: juan.duran@mail.mcgill.ca
paragraphs.zh: 通讯作者：juan.duran@mail.mcgill.ca

paragraphs.en: Hospitals regularly buy software that clinicians and patients depend on. Because these purchases are costly, hard to reverse and can affect patient care, buyers look for evidence of which peer institutions already use a product and which systems it connects to. This evidence is public but scattered across vendor websites, press releases and third-party pages. Language-model agents can now collect it at low cost, but the correctness of the extracted claims is difficult to establish, and a wrongly listed customer can mislead buyers and misrepresent an organisation. We present a pipeline that builds a knowledge graph of customer and integration relations from the open web under one rule: every edge must be supported by a verbatim quote from its source page. Pages come from a deterministic crawl of each vendor’s site and a budgeted ReAct agent that searches the rest of the web. A permissive extractor proposes relations with quotes, and a layered grounding stage decides which to keep, using a referent step that reads the whole page when a quote names only one side, deterministic checks, and a panel of five model calls voting on nine criteria. On 61 vendors, the pipeline reaches 0.94 precision and 0.71 recall against a page-level key covering the 6,428 candidate relations proposed by its extractor, whose verdicts were drafted by one model and re-checked with a second. Against the golden reference, the marketplace’s own curated list, it scores lower, but 89% of the relations it keeps that the reference lacks are stated on a page. A confidence score built from the panel’s votes keeps more correct relations than the fixed rule at the same precision, and reaches 0.90 precision at 0.90 recall. We also discuss how narrow, bounded model calls, string-matched evidence and voting address long-context degradation and run-to-run variance.

paragraphs.en: Hospitals and health systems regularly need new software, from electronic health record modules and revenue-cycle tools to ambient scribes. These purchases are costly and hard to reverse once a product is built into clinical and administrative workflows, and they affect patients because clinicians use these tools while delivering care. Before buying, teams therefore look for evidence that a product works in practice: which peer institutions already use it, and which of their existing systems it connects to. This evidence is public, but it is spread across vendor case studies, testimonials, customer logos, press releases and integration marketplaces.
paragraphs.zh: 医院和医疗系统经常需要新软件，从电子健康记录模块、收入周期工具到环境式语音记录助手。 这些采购成本高昂，而且一旦产品嵌入临床和行政工作流程中就难以逆转，同时由于临床医生在提供诊疗时使用这些工具，它们也会影响患者。 因此，团队在购买之前会寻找产品在实践中行之有效的证据：哪些同类机构已经在使用它，以及它能连接到哪些现有系统。 这些证据是公开的，但散落在供应商案例研究、客户推荐、客户标志、新闻稿和集成市场之中。

paragraphs.en: We developed our pipeline with Elion, 1 1 1 https://elion.health/ a marketplace that gathers this evidence so that buyers can compare products. paragraphs.zh: 我们与 Elion（https://elion.health/）共同开发了我们的流水线，这是一个汇集此类证据以便买方比较产品的市场平台。 对于每个产品，它会记录客户（使用该产品的机构）和集成（与其连接的其他产品）。 在这样的目录中，错误的客户比缺失的客户危害更大：它可能让买方基于错误的理由信任某个产品，并使一家医院与一个它可能并不使用的产品关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Language models can now read web pages at scale and at low cost, which makes it possible to collect this evidence for every product in a catalogue. Their judgements, however, need checking. On one vendor’s website, the same one-sentence testimonial, attributed to the same practice administrator, appears on several partner pages, each time under a different company’s name. When we asked a large language model whether each of these pages shows that company using the product, it answered yes for three of them and no for a fourth, although the sentence was identical. More generally, models tend to say yes when asked whether a page supports a claim, can answer the same question differently on different runs, and produce worse output as the amount they must read or report at once increases.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型如今能够以大规模、低成本的方式阅读网页，这使得为目录中的每个产品收集此类证据成为可能。 然而，模型的判断需要核查。 在某一家供应商的网站上，同一条单句推荐语、署名同一位机构管理人员，出现在多个合作方页面上，而每次署名的公司名称却各不相同。 当我们询问一个大语言模型这些页面是否分别表明该公司在使用该产品时，它对其中三个页面回答“是”，对第四个回答“否”，尽管句子完全相同。 更普遍地说，当被问及某个页面是否支持某项主张时，模型倾向于回答“是”，在不同运行中可能对同一问题给出不同答案，并且当它们必须一次性阅读或报告的内容增多时，输出质量会下降。

paragraphs.en: The pipeline is built around one rule: every edge needs a quote . A relation is added to the graph only if it is supported by a verbatim span of a specific retained page, stored with the page’s URL and retrieval time. This applies the notion of attribution of Rashkin et al. [22] at the moment each edge is written. A quote lets anyone check an edge, but it does not make the edge correct, so most of the pipeline is concerned with deciding whether a quoted relation is actually supported.

paragraphs.en: Worked example: one relation through the pipeline 1. Discovery. The crawl of Abridge’s own site retrieves a blog post titled Inside Northwestern Medicine’s Evidence-Based Evaluation of AI . It names the product, so it passes the relevance gate and is cached. 2. Extraction. The extractor proposes Northwestern Medicine Adopts Abridge , with the quote: “Today, after 3 months, we’re already reaching the point where clinician demand exceeds our available licenses.” 3. Referent. The quote names neither the hospital nor the product, so the referent reads the whole page with the prompt for customer relations on vendor pages. It confirms, arguing that “the Abridge-owned page describes Northwestern Medicine selecting Abridge after a multi-vendor evaluation and reports 1,300+ clinicians live with active utilization, establishing current use by the named health system.” 4. Shape checks. The subject is a named organisation and the quote is on the page as one span, so nothing is rejected. 5. Semantic panel. All five calls say yes on each of the five criteria that gate a customer relation. One call’s reason notes that the testimonial’s “we” refers to Northwestern Medicine, which is the reference the referent step is designed to resolve. 6. Graph. The relation is kept; in the live pipeline it is written to Neo4j with its quote, the page URL and the retrieval time. The page-level key agrees that the page supports it.
paragraphs.zh: 实例演示：一条关系经过整个流水线。1. 发现。 对 Abridge 自身网站的抓取取回了一篇题为《西北医学对 AI 的循证评估内幕》的博客文章。 文中提到了该产品，因此通过了相关性门槛，并被缓存。2. 抽取。 抽取器提出了「西北医学采用 Abridge」这一关系，引用语为：“今天，仅 3 个月后，我们已经到了临床医生需求超过我们现有许可数量的地步。”3. 指代对象。 这条引用语既没有提到医院名称，也没有提到产品名称，因此指代解析步骤使用针对供应商页面上客户关系的提示词读取了整个页面。 它确认了该关系，理由是：“这个由 Abridge 所有的页面描述了西北医学在多供应商评估后选择 Abridge，并报告已有 1,300 多名临床医生在实际使用中活跃使用该产品，确立了所命名医疗系统当前的采用情况。”4. 形态检查。 主体是一个具名组织，且引用语在页面上以单一连续片段的形式存在，因此没有任何内容被拒绝。5. 语义评审组。 全部五次调用在决定客户关系的五项标准上均给出肯定答案。 其中一次调用的理由指出，这条证言中的“我们”指的是西北医学，而这正是指代解析步骤所要解决的引用问题。6. 图谱。 该关系被保留；在实时流水线中，它会连同其引用语、页面 URL 和检索时间一起写入 Neo4j。 页面级键确认该页面支持此关系。

paragraphs.en: Because the vendor’s domain is known, this half is a deterministic sweep with no model calls. A Firecrawl [ 5 ] map call lists up to 1,000 URLs from the site root, with the product’s own section of the site listed first. URLs are normalised, technical pages (static assets, login pages, sitemaps, developer documentation) are excluded with a recorded reason, and the remaining pages are scraped as Markdown and cached with their retrieval time. Some evidence only appears after interaction, so for each vendor page a headless browser also opens up to five tabs, filters or “load more” buttons, and records the alternative text of logos placed under evidence headings. Finally, a relevance gate drops any page that does not name the product; dropped pages are kept on record but never extracted.
paragraphs.zh: 由于供应商的域名是已知的，这一半工作是一次确定性的遍历，不涉及任何模型调用。 Firecrawl [5] 的 map 调用从网站根目录列出最多 1,000 个 URL，其中该产品所属的网站板块排在最前。 URL 经过规范化处理，技术页面（静态资源、登录页、站点地图、开发者文档）会被排除并记录原因，其余页面被抓取为 Markdown，并连同其获取时间一起缓存。 有些证据只有在交互之后才会出现，因此对于每个供应商页面，无头浏览器还会打开最多五个标签页，操作筛选器或「加载更多」按钮，并记录置于证据标题下方的标志（logo）的替代文本。 最后，一个相关性门槛会丢弃任何未提及该产品名称的页面；被丢弃的页面会保留在记录中，但永远不会被提取。

paragraphs.en: Outside the vendor’s site, the set of relevant pages is not known in advance, so an agent searches for them. One ReAct-style agent [ 27 ] per relation type can search the web, map and crawl sites, and read pages. Every tool call must state a reason, which is logged, so each decision can be audited. The agent cannot read the vendor’s own domain, and it cannot read a short list of hosts that only add noise: social networks, job boards, app stores, the marketplace’s own site, and three aggregator sites that produced fabricated relations. It can only read a page whose URL a search, map or crawl has already returned.
paragraphs.zh: 在供应商网站之外，相关页面的集合事先并不知晓，因此由智能体去搜索它们。 每种关系类型使用一个 ReAct 风格的智能体 [ 27 ]，它可以搜索网络、对站点进行地图查询与爬取，并阅读页面。 每次工具调用都必须说明理由，且该理由会被记录下来，因此每个决策都可被审计。 该智能体不能读取供应商自己的域名，也不能读取一份只会带来噪音的主机列表：社交网络、招聘网站、应用商店、该市场的自有站点，以及三个曾产生虚假关系的聚合网站。 它只能读取其 URL 已由搜索、地图查询或爬取返回过的页面。

paragraphs.en: The agent works under hard budgets (25 searches and 15 page reads per agent), and each page it reads is truncated to 20,000 characters. Before it starts, it receives up to eight customer names already confirmed on vendor pages as search leads. It ends by returning the pages it wants to keep, each with a reason. Those pages are cached and pass through exactly the same extraction and grounding as vendor pages.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体在严格的预算限制下工作（每个智能体最多 25 次搜索和 15 次页面读取），并且它读取的每一页都会被截断至 20,000 个字符。 在开始之前，它会收到最多八个已在供应商页面上确认的客户名称，作为搜索线索。 它最后会返回自己想要保留的页面，每页附上一个理由。 这些页面会被缓存，并与供应商页面经过完全相同的提取和 grounding 处理。

The prompt receives the target product’s name and the graph entities already known to appear on the page, and returns a list of relations, each with a quote. The extractor is deliberately permissive: when the wording is ambiguous it extracts anyway, and leaves the decision to grounding. Three instructions carry most of the weight:

paragraphs.en: quote one contiguous evidence span, copied from the visible text , so that every quote can be verified;
paragraphs.zh: 请引用一段连续的证据文本，该文本需从可见文本中原样复制，以便每条引用都可被验证；

paragraphs.en: include enough adjacent heading or sentences for both names and the relationship cue to appear in that span , because proof is often split between a heading and the line under it;
paragraphs.zh: 包含足够的相邻标题或句子，以使两个名称及其关系提示都出现在该文本片段中，因为证据常常被拆分在标题与其下方的行中；

paragraphs.zh: 采用不是一项投资、一个奖项或网络成员资格，这一点与什么才算数的表述同样明确。

paragraphs.en: Before grounding, each endpoint is matched to the entities already in the graph, so that one hospital under several spellings is not counted several times. A name that exactly matches a known entity on the page is resolved directly; otherwise Graphiti’s resolver [ 23 ] tries normalised names, fuzzy matching and finally a model call. Only health organisations may be added as new entities; a product that matches nothing is rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 在落地（grounding）之前，每个端点会先与图中已有的实体进行匹配，以免同一家医院的几种拼写被重复计算多次。 与页面上已知实体完全匹配的名称会被直接解析；否则由 Graphiti 的解析器 [ 23 ] 依次尝试规范化名称、模糊匹配，最后再调用模型。 只有医疗健康类组织才能作为新实体添加；匹配不到任何内容的药品会被拒收。

paragraphs.en: Asked for one unbroken span, the extractor sometimes joins two genuine pieces of the page and drops the few characters between them, for example between a testimonial and its attribution line. This happens to about one quote in eleven. When the quote matches the page (at least 75% of its characters) but is not one contiguous run, it is replaced by the page’s own text spanning the matched pieces, and the relation is sent to the referent.

paragraphs.en: Many quotes name only one side of a relation: a testimonial names the hospital but not the product, or the product appears only in the page title. It reads the whole page and returns an argument, a yes/no verdict and a proof sentence copied from the page, which must be found in the original text. A refusal rejects the relation. On a vendor’s own site, a case study or customer spotlight is the vendor presenting a customer; on a third party’s page, a list of names often describes the page owner’s own clients (Appendix C ). paragraphs.en: Fourteen deterministic checks (Appendix B ) reject structural failures at no model cost, such as a generic endpoint (“hospitals”), a person in place of an organisation, a quote that is not on the page, a self-edge, or a name that appears only inside a link’s URL.

paragraphs.en: Five identical model calls judge each remaining relation independently. Each call answers nine yes/no criteria (Table 8 ), and a criterion passes when at least half of the returned votes are yes. A relation is rejected if any criterion that applies to its type fails: five criteria apply to customer relations and seven to integrations. The panel does not see the whole page: it sees the section that best matches the quote, found by splitting the page at its headings and capped at 6,000 characters, plus anything the referent passed on. All five votes are recorded for every relation.

paragraphs.en: We use one corpus and two benchmarks that answer different questions: the page-level key asks whether a page states a relation, and the golden reference is the marketplace’s own list of customers and integrations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个语料库和两个基准测试，它们回答不同的问题：页面级标准询问的是一个页面是否陈述了某种关系，而黄金参考是该市场自身的客户与集成列表。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation covers the 61 products in the golden reference. We ran extraction once over every cached page for these products (9 October 2026), recording for every candidate whether it was kept, the gate that rejected it, the referent’s decision and each of the five votes. All model calls in this pass used openai/gpt-6-luna , with every prompt pinned to a recorded version. Two grounding components were finalised after this pass: the splice repair and the referent prompt for customer relations on vendor pages. The candidates they affect (570 with spliced quotes and 306 that the referent had refused) were re-run through the final grounding stage, so the results describe the final pipeline. The pass produced 6,429 candidate relations from 3,284 pages: 2,952 on vendor sites and 332 third-party pages found by the discovery agent. One candidate could not be judged, because its organisation is named only in an image’s alt text, which leaves 6,428 (Table 2 ).

paragraphs.en: The golden reference is the marketplace’s own record, exported from its production database and maintained by its annotation team: 749 customers and 249 integrations over the 61 products. Four products list no customers and fifteen list no integrations. Its unit is the pair (vendor, organisation), so page-level output is collapsed before scoring: a pair counts as predicted if any page kept it. Names are matched after normalisation with a string-similarity threshold of 0.82, which absorbs spelling variants. The reference is correct about what it lists but incomplete in two ways. It lists organisations that no page in the corpus mentions, so recall measured against it is a lower bound. And many real customers that vendors publish are missing from it, so precision measured against it is too low. For 239 customers and 51 integrations, the only proof is on third-party pages, which only the discovery agent can reach.
paragraphs.zh: 黄金参考答案是市场平台自身的记录，从其生产数据库导出并由其标注团队维护：61 个产品共有 749 个客户和 249 个集成。 四个产品未列出任何客户，十五个产品未列出任何集成。 其单位是（供应商，组织）对，因此在评分前会先合并页面级输出：只要任一页面保留了某一对，该对即计为已预测。 名称匹配在归一化后进行，字符串相似度阈值为 0.82，可以吸收拼写变体。 该参考答案在所列内容上是正确的，但在两个方面不完整。 它列出了一些语料库中没有任何页面提及的组织，因此以它衡量的召回率是下界。 并且许多供应商发布的真实客户未包含在其中，因此以它衡量的准确率偏低。 对于 239 个客户和 51 个集成，唯一的证据在第三方页面上，只有发现智能体能够访问这些页面。

paragraphs.en: The page-level key asks: “does this page support this relation?” Every candidate, kept or not, was judged by openai/gpt-5.6-sol (GPT-5.6 Sol), a stronger model tier than the pipeline’s. It read the whole page and answered YES or NO with a one-sentence justification (prompts in Appendix C ). There is one verdict per distinct (page, relation), so the same relation on two pages is judged twice. Because every candidate is labelled, the decision threshold can be moved in both directions (Section 5.4 ). Claude Opus 5 (Anthropic) then re-checked every verdict against about 900 characters of page text around the quote, and the first author read a subset (the records do not mark which entries). Of the 6,428 verdicts, 911 (14%) were reversed, each with a written reason. A candidate counts as correct if its final verdict is YES.
paragraphs.zh: 页面级键值问的是：“该页面是否支持该关系？”每个候选，无论是否保留，都由 openai/gpt-5.6-sol（GPT-5.6 Sol）判定，这是一个比流水线所用模型更强的模型层级。 它阅读整个页面，并以一句理由回答 YES 或 NO（提示词见附录 C）。 每个不同的（页面，关系）组合只有一个判定结果，因此同一关系在两个页面上会被判定两次。 由于每个候选都有标注，决策阈值可以向两个方向移动（见 5.4 节）。 Claude Opus 5（Anthropic）随后针对引文周围约 900 字符的页面文本重新核查了每个判定结果，第一作者也阅读了其中一部分（记录中并未标明是哪些条目）。 在 6,428 个判定结果中，有 911 个（14%）被推翻，每个都附有书面理由。 如果候选的最终判定结果为 YES，则该候选计为正确。

paragraphs.en: With true positives (TP), false positives (FP) and false negatives (FN) counted at each benchmark’s own unit, we report precision P = TP / ( TP + FP ) P=\mathrm{TP}/(\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}) , recall R = TP / ( TP + FN ) R=\mathrm{TP}/(\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FN}) and F 1 = 2 ​ P ​ R / ( P + R ) F_{1}=2PR/(P+R) . On the page-level key, recall is measured over the candidates the extractor proposed, so it describes the grounding stages; a relation the extractor never proposed is invisible to this key. The golden reference does see extraction recall, but mixes it with its own gaps.

paragraphs.en: Most of the signal comes from the panel’s votes. The share of the five calls agreeing that the claim is supported reaches F1 0.864 on its own, and a model with five features performs nearly as well as the full model (Appendix D ). The referent helps when the panel is split: relations the referent confirmed are then 0.89 correct, and those it refused 0.33. Two cautions apply. First, the heaviest weight in most fitted models is the flag marking a customer relation, which reflects this corpus’s base rate rather than evidence about the relation, and should be removed before the score is used elsewhere. Second, no signal describes what kind of page the evidence came from (a case study, a logo wall, a navigation banner repeated across the site), and that is where the remaining errors concentrate.
paragraphs.zh: 大部分信号来自评审团的投票。 五次判定一致认为该论断得到支持的份额本身就达到 F1 0.864，且包含五个特征的模型表现与完整模型几乎相当（附录 D）。 当评审团意见分裂时，参照对象能发挥作用：经参照对象确认的关系随后有 0.89 的正确率，而它拒绝的关系正确率为 0.33。需要注意两点。 首先，在大多数拟合模型中权重最大的是标记客户关系的标志，这反映的是本语料库的基础比率而非关于该关系的证据，因此在把该分数用于其他场景之前应将其移除。 其次，没有任何信号描述证据来自何种页面（案例研究、仅展示标志的墙面、在整站重复出现的导航横幅），而这正是剩余错误集中的地方。

sents.zh: 五次判定一致认为该论断得到支持的份额本身就达到 F1 0.864，且包含五个特征的模型表现与完整模型几乎相当（附录 D）。

sents.en: The referent helps when the panel is split: relations the referent confirmed are then 0.89 correct, and those it refused 0.33. Two cautions apply.
sents.zh: 当评审团意见分裂时，参照对象能发挥作用：经参照对象确认的关系随后有 0.89 的正确率，而它拒绝的关系正确率为 0.33。需要注意两点。

sents.en: First, the heaviest weight in most fitted models is the flag marking a customer relation, which reflects this corpus’s base rate rather than evidence about the relation, and should be removed before the score is used elsewhere.
sents.zh: 首先，在大多数拟合模型中权重最大的是标记客户关系的标志，这反映的是本语料库的基础比率而非关于该关系的证据，因此在把该分数用于其他场景之前应将其移除。

sents.en: Second, no signal describes what kind of page the evidence came from (a case study, a logo wall, a navigation banner repeated across the site), and that is where the remaining errors concentrate.
sents.zh: 其次，没有任何信号描述证据来自何种页面（案例研究、仅展示标志的墙面、在整站重复出现的导航横幅），而这正是剩余错误集中的地方。

paragraphs.en: Two properties of language models shaped the design more than the choice of model: their output degrades as their input or output grows, and it varies from run to run. This section describes how the pipeline handles each and how its prompts were tuned.
paragraphs.zh: 相比模型的选择，语言模型的两个特性更多地影响了设计：随着输入或输出的增长，其输出质量会下降；且每次运行的结果都有所不同。 本节描述该流水线如何处理这两种情况，以及其提示词是如何调优的。

paragraphs.en: A model’s output degrades as the amount it must read or report at once grows [ 13 ] , and the corpus shows this directly. The extractor’s splicing rate rises with the number of relations it must report in one call: 6 in 100 quotes when it reports one relation, and 15 in 100 when it reports four to seven. The discovery agent faces the same pressure, because search results and page text accumulate over a session. The pipeline responds in three ways.
paragraphs.zh: 模型的输出质量会随着其一次性需要读取或报告的内容量增长而下降 [ 13 ]，语料库直接印证了这一点。 抽取器的拼接错误率随其单次调用需报告的关系数量上升：报告一个关系时为每 100 条引用中 6 条，报告四到七个关系时为每 100 条中 15 条。 发现智能体面临同样的压力，因为搜索结果和页面文本会在整个会话过程中不断累积。 该流水线以三种方式作出应对。

paragraphs.en: The prompts share a few principles. The semantic panel asks for explicit criteria as separate yes/no fields rather than one overall verdict. The grounding prompts state what does not count (an investment, an award, network membership, a bare logo) as clearly as what does. The referent prompts give a worked YES example and a worked NO example, ask for the argument before the verdict, and ask for a proof sentence copied verbatim so that it can be string-matched. Separate referent prompts for vendor and third-party pages also help: on 216 customer relations on vendor pages, the vendor-page prompt reaches F1 0.975 over seven runs, against 0.955 for a single generic prompt over three (Wilcoxon signed-rank p = 0.014 p=0.014 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些提示词遵循几条共同原则。 语义评估面板要求将明确的标准拆分为单独的是/否字段，而不是给出一个总体判定。 依据核查类提示词对「什么不算依据」（如一笔投资、一个奖项、网络成员关系、一个孤立的标识）与「什么算依据」表述得同样清晰。 指涉对象类提示词给出一个详细的「是」示例和一个详细的「否」示例，要求先给出论证再给出判定，并要求逐字复制一句可进行字符串匹配的证明句。 为厂商页面和第三方页面分别设置指涉对象提示词也有帮助：在 216 条厂商页面客户关系上，厂商页面专用提示词在七次运行中达到 F1 0.975，而单一通用提示词在三次运行中仅为 0.955（Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 p = 0.014 p=0.014）。

paragraphs.en: Web-scale knowledge bases such as Knowledge Vault fuse noisy extractions into probabilistic facts [ 3 ] . Distant supervision uses an existing knowledge base as labels and inherits its gaps as false negatives [ 15 ] , a positive–unlabelled setting [ 4 ] that our golden reference shares. Language models are now widely used for relation extraction and graph construction [ 25 , 20 , 1 ] ; GraphJudge uses a model to filter candidate triples [ 9 ] , close in spirit to our semantic panel. We store the graph with Graphiti, the engine behind Zep’s temporal knowledge graph [ 23 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 Knowledge Vault 之类的网络级知识库将噪声抽取结果融合为概率性事实 [ 3 ] 。 远程监督使用现有知识库作为标签，并将其缺口继承为假负例 [ 15 ] ，这是一种正例—未标注（positive–unlabelled）设定 [ 4 ] ，我们的黄金参考同样采用该设定。 语言模型如今被广泛用于关系抽取与图谱构建 [ 25 , 20 , 1 ] ；GraphJudge 使用模型来过滤候选三元组 [ 9 ] ，其精神与我们的语义评审组相近。 我们使用 Graphiti 存储图谱，它是 Zep 的时序知识库背后的引擎 [ 23 ] 。

We apply attribution when each edge is written and verify against the unmodified page.

paragraphs.en: Our discovery agent follows ReAct [ 27 ] , as browsing agents such as WebGPT do [ 16 ] ; retrieval-augmented generation is the broader family [ 12 ] . Models used as judges are useful but biased and inconsistent [ 28 ] , and majority voting over samples improves reliability [ 26 ] ; our panel votes per criterion and records every vote.

paragraphs.en: Label errors in test sets can change which model appears best [ 18 ] . Every verdict of our page-level key was re-checked. Treating reference data as a component to audit, rather than fixed infrastructure, follows the internal-audit framing of Raji et al. [21] and the system-level view of Sculley et al. [24] . paragraphs.en: Language-model agents make it inexpensive to extract claims from the web, but those claims must be verified before anyone acts on them. We presented a pipeline that builds a graph of healthcare software adoption and integration in which every edge points to its source sentence and page, and in which narrow model calls and deterministic checks decide which quoted relations to keep. On 61 vendors it reaches 0.94 precision and 0.71 recall against a re-checked page-level key, and most of the relations it finds beyond the golden reference are stated on a page. A confidence score built from its recorded votes lets the catalogue’s owners choose their own balance between precision and recall. Our design recommendations are: give each model call one task and a bounded input, check deterministically whatever can be checked, use votes instead of single calls, and review the evaluation labels before relying on scores.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型智能体使得从网页中提取声明变得低成本，但任何人依据这些声明采取行动之前，必须先对其进行验证。 我们提出了一个流水线，用于构建医疗软件采用与集成的关系图，图中每条边都指向其来源句子和页面，并通过窄范围模型调用和确定性检查来决定保留哪些引用关系。 在 61 家供应商上，该系统对照经复核的页面级参考答案达到 0.94 的精确率和 0.71 的召回率，且其发现的大多数超出黄金参考的关系都能在页面上找到明确表述。 由其记录的投票构建的置信度分数，让目录的所有者能够自行选择精确率与召回率之间的平衡。 我们的设计建议是：让每次模型调用只执行一个任务且输入有界，凡能确定性检查的一律进行检查，用投票代替单次调用，并在依赖分数之前先复核评估标签。

paragraphs.en: The pipeline consists of two LangGraph state machines. The outer graph maps and fetches the vendor’s site, plans and runs extraction over the retained pages, then starts one discovery agent per relation type and sends the pages they keep back through planning and extraction once. The inner graph handles one page: it loads the cached page, extracts candidates, resolves their endpoints, runs grounding, writes the surviving edges and records the outcome. All model calls go through OpenRouter.
paragraphs.zh: 该流水线由两个 LangGraph 状态机组成。 外层图负责映射并抓取供应商网站，对保留的页面进行规划并运行抽取，然后为每种关系类型启动一个智能体，并将这些智能体保留的页面再次送回规划与抽取环节，且仅此一次。 内层图处理单个页面：它加载已缓存的页面，抽取候选条目，解析其端点，运行接地校验，写入保留下来的边并记录处理结果。 所有模型调用均通过 OpenRouter 进行。

paragraphs.en: The agent is built with the deepagents library. Tool budgets are reserved atomically so that parallel tool calls cannot exceed them. Before the agent starts, one fixed opening search is run. The pages the agent keeps are checked against the URLs it actually observed, and the selection is topped up deterministically with observed pages whose title or search snippet names the product.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体基于 deepagents 库构建。 工具预算以原子方式预留，因此并行的工具调用不会超出预算。 在智能体启动之前，会先运行一次固定的开场搜索。 智能体保留的页面会与它实际观察到的 URL 进行核对，并且会以确定性的方式，用标题或搜索摘要中提到该产品的已观察页面来补足选择结果。

paragraphs.en: The score is a logistic regression with light ridge regularisation. All results are out-of-sample under five-fold cross-validation; in the subset search, feature standardisation is computed on each training fold alone. We evaluated every subset of up to eight features (603,500 subsets), extended the forty best eight-feature subsets by beam search up to all 22 features, and separately searched 141,724 decision trees with up to five features and depth up to four. The search took about two hours of compute and no model calls.
paragraphs.zh: 该分数是一个采用轻度岭正则化的逻辑回归模型。 所有结果均为五折交叉验证下的样本外结果；在子集搜索中，特征标准化仅在每个训练折上单独计算。 我们评估了最多包含八个特征的所有子集（603,500 个子集），通过束搜索将四十个最佳的八特征子集扩展至全部 22 个特征，并另行搜索了最多包含五个特征且深度不超过四的 141,724 棵决策树。 该搜索耗时约两小时计算，且未调用任何模型。

paragraphs.en: The best F1 is 0.907, reached with thirteen features; the best five-feature model reaches 0.898, and the best tree 0.900. These values are optimistic, because each model was chosen from many candidates using the same folds that score it. Figure 3 uses all 22 features, with no selection. The tree reads as a rule: relations with a unanimous panel are 0.89 to 0.97 correct, and when the panel is split, those the referent confirmed are 0.89 correct and those it refused are 0.33. Being asked by the referent carries a negative weight where it appears, since the referent runs only when the quote cannot settle the relation alone. The customer-relation flag is the heaviest weight in most fitted models.
paragraphs.zh: 最好的 F1 为 0.907，使用了十三个特征达到；最好的五特征模型达到 0.898，最好的树达到 0.900。 这些值是乐观的，因为每个模型都是从许多候选中使用同样对其评分的折数选出的。 图 3 使用全部 22 个特征，没有进行任何选择。 这棵树可以读作一条规则：专家小组一致同意的关系有 0.89 到 0.97 的正确率，而当小组意见分裂时，被指称者确认的那些关系正确率为 0.89，被其拒绝的则为 0.33。 被指称者询问这一特征在其出现之处带有负权重，因为只有当引用无法单独确定关系时才会运行指称者。 客户关系标志在大多数拟合模型中是最重的权重。
